methodology: Counts are distinct, source-reviewed events in this curated dataset, not a census of all global activity. Coverage and editorial selection bias must be disclosed. Empty feeds are shown as unavailable, not zero.

event_contract.id: Stable unique event ID; repeated articles about one occurrence share one ID
event_contract.title: Specific verifiable description of what happened
event_contract.category: positive | negative | neutral; label is a provisional editorial assessment
event_contract.event_date: YYYY-MM-DD date of occurrence, not publication date

review_policy: Do not equate article sentiment with event impact.
Count distinct events, not articles or media mentions.
Require a specific occurrence, place, date, and source.
Review contradictory evidence and mixed outcomes before classification.
Disclose geographic, language, source-selection, and reporting-period limitations.
Do not present these counts as proof that the world is objectively improving or worsening.
